::: {.ter-project-brief}
## Seasonal design brief

Design or adapt a laser-cut ornament that can be personalized and hung safely. A reindeer is one possible worked idea, not the required design for every student.
:::

## Source and licence first

Original sketches are preferred. If a teacher-approved vector reference is used, record the creator, original page, licence and changes made. Use public-domain, open-licensed or otherwise permitted work; a search result thumbnail or “free SVG” label is not enough.

## Prepare the design

1. simplify the SVG and remove accidental overlaps, stray nodes and duplicate lines;
2. set the document units and intended physical scale;
3. check antlers, points, bridges and other small features against the actual material/process;
4. make the hanging hole large enough for the approved string or hook and leave enough material around it;
5. separate **CUT** geometry from **ENGRAVE** artwork using the local file convention;
6. add original personalization without weakening critical regions;
7. print at full size or cut a small approved test before producing the final ornament.

## Evaluate

Check silhouette, readable personalization, surface finish, hanging balance, fragile features, material use and whether the final work still respects its source licence. Record one change for a future version.

Return to [Laser Cutting & 2D Fabrication](index.qmd) or find open starting geometry in the [Laser Fabrication Library](../../teaching-materials/laser-cutting/?type=themed-starters#library).
